parent.name: Original frozen Stage1 complete allocator, unchanged action/risk/recovery chain

single_mechanism.formula: log(sqrt(252) * original_Stage1_soxx_vol20 / (original_Stage1_vix / 100)) on the exact original signal row; reject nonpositive or nonfinite source values. No clipping, percentile, lag, sign or window selection.
single_mechanism.hypothesis: When semiconductor realized volatility is high relative to broad-market implied fear, the disturbance is more sector-specific and more likely to repair over the next five SOXX funded open intervals than when broad fear leads. A positive added standardized coefficient is required. This is a nonlinear representation of two existing Stage1 inputs, not new raw information or a pure same-underlying variance risk premium.
single_mechanism.receiver: Original Stage1 primary allocation H5 return information task before any separate 0bp action/account experiment.
single_mechanism.novelty: Existing Stage1 contains soxx_vol20 and vix separately; this fixed log ratio supplies a specific scale-invariant interaction. The closed domain-head and conditional-variance routes changed training architecture or volatility estimates, not this exact original-Stage1 matched single-coordinate H5 information screen. The hypothesis was motivated by reused regime attribution; held history remains development-only.
single_mechanism.candidate: Same rows, label, imputer, scaler and Ridge plus exactly one fixed log ratio coordinate.

label.primary: Five consecutive original Stage1 SOXX funded open-to-open returns from signal s: sum j=0..4 log1p(soxx_forward_open_return(s+j)).
label.maturity: Original Stage1 timing.return_available_at of fifth interval; train strictly before 2023-01-01 America/New_York and held before 2026-10-10 America/New_York.
label.role: Matched incremental information only, not fee-net strategy return.

model.baseline: SimpleImputer(median) then StandardScaler then Ridge(alpha=1.0) on original 39 features
model.candidate: Identical pipeline plus one fixed log ratio coordinate

information_gate.paired_metric: On identical held signals, baseline squared error minus candidate squared error for five-open SOXX log return.

barrier: Run one no-fit native Qlib DatasetH source/maturity preflight, then independent exact-plan/preflight/fit-code review before first fit. The completed ADS information screen used family denominator 25; this is the next fixed candidate at 0.025/26. A pass only allows a separately frozen Stage1-derived full 0bp Tiered-fee account against SOXX; 2/5bp and qualified forward evidence remain separate.
stop: If sources, 39-feature identity, full cohort, formula finiteness or label maturity differs, stop. If any information gate fails, close this exact interaction without sign, scale, volatility window, benchmark, clipping or receiver changes on reused history.
